description:
**NOTICE**
- There is a bug/issue with importing a rigged fbx mesh on Sketchfab at the moment, causing odd displacement of the mesh (most noticeable on the teeth and spikes) which the original mesh does not have.

Being one of the **BIG THREE** largest theropods, the **Giganotosaurus** surely lives up to its name. Though reconstructed as jagged, spiky, and crocodilian-like in a certain movie franchise, here the creature is reconstructed with accurate anatomy and musculature in mind, alongside 3 uniquely designed skins that give the animal 3 distinct yet plausible looks.

The 3D model is Production-Ready, featuring the **new version 3.0 Rig Type**, which includes advanced rig controls, muscle-like movements and deformation, added new precise controls, FK & IK bones, stretch bones and jiggle bones, with added new corrective joints, and with the custom Rig UI N-panel.

name: KIRIK KIRIK BIRU (BLUE THROATED BEE EATER)
description:
Kirik-kirik biru merupakan burung berukuran sedang dengan tubuh ramping dan bulu berwarna mencolok. Panjang tubuhnya berkisar 21–23 cm, dengan dua helai bulu ekor tengah yang memanjang dan runcing, menambah kesan elegan saat terbang. Kepala dan tengkuk berwarna cokelat kemerahan, kontras indah dengan tenggorokan dan dada biru terang yang menjadi ciri khasnya.

Bagian punggung dan sayap atas berwarna hijau zamrud berkilau, sementara bagian bawah tubuh menampilkan gradasi biru kehijauan yang lembut. Paruhnya panjang, hitam, dan melengkung ke bawah, disertai mata merah tua yang memberikan ekspresi tajam dan fokus.

Kakinya sangat kecil dan ramping, berwarna hitam keabu-abuan, tampak mungil dibandingkan tubuhnya. Struktur kakinya yang terdiri dari tiga jari menghadap ke depan dan satu ke belakang memudahkannya untuk bertengger di ranting atau kawat tipis. Saat terbang, kirik-kirik biru tampak lincah dan anggun dengan sayap runcing dan gerakan melayang yang halus.

name: Dinoraul's Brachiosaurus Althitorax Accurate
description:
Credit to @SaurustheModeler
Brachiosaurus is a genus of sauropod dinosaur that lived in North America during the Late Jurassic, about 155.6 to 145.5 million years ago. It was first described by American paleontologist Elmer S. Riggs in 1903 from fossils found in the Colorado River valley in western Colorado, United States. Riggs named the dinosaur Brachiosaurus altithorax; the generic name is Greek for "arm lizard", in reference to its proportionately long arms, and the specific name means "deep chest". Brachiosaurus is estimated to have been between 18 and 22 meters (59 and 72 ft) long; body mass estimates of the subadult holotype specimen range from 28.3 to 46.9 metric tons (31.2 to 51.7 short tons). It had a disproportionately long neck, small skull, and large overall size, all of which are typical for sauropods. Atypically, Brachiosaurus had longer forelimbs than hindlimbs, which resulted in a steeply inclined trunk, and a proportionally shorter tail.https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brachiosaurus

name: Ivysaur
description:
A low-poly **Ivysaur model** designed for a **Minecraft Bedrock Edition addon**, combining the recognizable Pokémon design with Minecraft’s blocky and geometric visual style.

name: Etruscan seal (right astragalus)
description:
3D scan of the right astragalus of the Etruscan seal (*Pliophoca etrusca*).

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

A highly detailed 3D representation inspired by the unique anatomy and appearance of the Sri Lankan leopard.

• Leopard rosette pattern accuracy
• Realistic eye and nose detailing
• Muscle flow and body anatomy
• Natural paw and claw structure
• High-resolution skin and fur texture work
• Cinematic rendering and lighting presentation

Developed as a wildlife visualization and digital sculpting study with a focus on realism and biological accuracy.

**Stage:** adult - female

Allosaurus was a large bipedal predator for its time. Its skull was light, robust, and equipped with dozens of sharp, serrated teeth. It averaged 8.5 metres (28 ft) in length for A. fragilis, with the largest specimens estimated as being 9.7 metres (32 ft) long. Relative to the large and powerful legs, its three-fingered hands were small and the body was balanced by a long, muscular tail. It is classified as an allosaurid, a type of carnosaurian theropod dinosaur.

name: Pelecanimimus
description: from carnivores dh (carnivores dinosaur hunter reborn) It is an NPC in the game that cannot be collected in the trophy room. (It lived in the early Cretaceous period, just over 125 million years ago, in the Barremian, in what is now Europe. Its exceptionally well-preserved fossil remains have been found at the Las Hoyas site in Cuenca, Spain. It is notable for having more teeth than any other member of Ornithomimosauria, most of which are toothless. The only known specimen consists of the articulated front half of a skeleton including the skull, all the neck and most of the dorsal vertebrae, ribs, sternum, pectoral girdle, the complete right forelimb and most of the left. The specific name, Pelecanimimus polyodon, from the Greek polys, "many," plus odus, teeth, was given because it was the toothiest theropod known.)

It inhabits North, Central and South America, making it the most widely distributed wild, terrestrial mammal in the Western Hemisphere, and one of the most widespread in the world. Its range spans Yukon, British Columbia and Alberta in Canada, the Rocky Mountains and areas in the western United States. Further south, its range extends through Mexico to the Amazon rainforest and the southern Andes Mountains in Patagonia. name: Mantis religiosa - Inverse Kinematics
description:
*Mantis religiosa* - Inverse Kinematics (IK)

<hr>

ETAIN - Task 4.1 Development of 3D-EM Insect Models 

CT scan to 3D model process made by [Felipe Ribas](https://orcid.org/0009-0003-0433-4542) using Blender.

Introducing inverse kinematics and animation into simulations of RF EMF is highly beneficial for visualizing Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) and the pattern of electric fields in various positions, as they naturally occur. This integration allows for dynamic modeling of human and animal movements, offering a more accurate and realistic representation of how electromagnetic fields interact with biological tissues.

<hr>

ETAIN has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation program under grant agreement No. 101057216

name: KIRIK KIRIK SULAWESI
description:
Kirik-kirik Sulawesi merupakan burung endemik berukuran sedang dari Pulau Sulawesi, dengan panjang tubuh mencapai 24–25 cm. Ciri khas utamanya terletak pada janggot lebat berwarna ungu kehitaman yang menonjol di daerah dagu dan tenggorokan bagian bawah, memberikan kesan dramatis pada tampilan wajahnya.

Bulu tubuh bagian atas umumnya berwarna hijau zaitun gelap, kontras dengan dada dan perut berwarna ungu keunguan yang kaya dan dalam. Kepala dan pipinya tampak lebih gelap, seringkali tampak seperti menyatu dengan paruh yang panjang, hitam, dan melengkung khas keluarga pemakan serangga terbang.

Sayapnya berwarna hijau zaitun kehitaman dengan kilau metalik samar saat terkena cahaya. Ekor kirik-kirik ini terdiri dari bulu panjang berbentuk meruncing mengikuti tubuh, tanpa helai ekor ekstrem seperti yang dimili, memberi kesan tenang dan uh konsentrasi.

Kakinya kecil dan berwarna gelap, berfungsi terutama untuk bertengger di ranting-ranting rendah hutan dataran rendah dan perbukitan.

name: Random Pawpads 003
description:
Umm... hi there. I know I am absolutely out of my element here, but I decided I wanted to share this here... just in case anyone... I don't know, actually wants this, for some reason.

Long story short, using a horrible AI-generated image as a reference, I created this set of plump pawpads as a test to try to make some pawpads with as minimal polygons as possible. As one might gather from my name, pretty much all I've done in Blender thus far is create paws or simply pawpads, but so far they've all been sculpts resulting in insanely high poly counts due to the remeshing which is why I've hesitated to upload any of them here.

This one, however, I created largely using the modeling method, then sculpted it a little bit to smoothen out the shape remeshing as lightly as possible when necessary. I like how this turned out and I hope you do, too! I mean... for whatever you might need pawpads this plump for.

Personally, I've just been playing around with them using rigid body physics, so, to each their own.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
description: Tyrannosaurus is a genus of large theropod dinosaur. The type species Tyrannosaurus rex (rex meaning 'king' in Latin), often shortened to T. rex or colloquially t-rex, is one of the best represented theropods. It lived throughout what is now western North America, on what was then an island continent known as Laramidia. Tyrannosaurus had a much wider range than other tyrannosaurids. Fossils are found in a variety of geological formations dating to the latest Campanian-Maastrichtian ages of the late Cretaceous period, 72.7 to 66 million years ago, with isolated specimens possibly indicating an earlier origin in the middle Campanian. It was the last known member of the tyrannosaurids and among the last non-avian dinosaurs to exist before the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event.https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tyrannosaurus

name: Spider Cow
description:
**The Spidercow: A Nightmare Bred in the Hollow Vale**

In the fog-choked marshes of Hollow Vale, villagers whisper of the Spidercow, a grotesque fusion of bovine bulk and arachnid limbs. Born from a failed alchemical ritual meant to cure livestock disease, the Spidercow emerged when a dying cow was injected with spider ichor harvested from the Vale’s venomous pit-dwellers. Instead of healing, the creature mutated overnight, sprouting eight clawed legs and a maw lined with tusks.

Legends say it weaves webs from sinew and bone, dragging prey into its lair beneath the old mill. Its multiple eyes reflect torchlight like wet obsidian, and its bellow, half moo, half screech, echoes through the valley during moonless nights. Farmers leave offerings of salt and iron at crossroads to ward it off, but sightings persist. Some claim it guards a buried relic, others believe it’s multiplying. Either way, the Spidercow is no myth. It’s waiting.

name: Spea bombifrons (MSB:Herp:106628)
description:
The Plains spadefoot toad lives in the central U.S., southern Canada, and northern Mexico. Named for the black “spade” on its hind feet, it digs into sandy soil and spends most of its life underground. After heavy rains, it emerges to breed in temporary pools. Its call sounds like a snore, and its tadpoles can develop in just days before the pools dry. It can speed up or delay development based on environmental conditions—an adaptation to dry habitats (Bragg; Pfennig). It helps balance prairie ecosystems by eating insects and serving as prey.

References:

* Bragg, A. N. (1965). Gnomes of the Night: The Spadefoot Toads.
* Pfennig, D. W. (1992). Polyphenism in spadefoot toad tadpoles as a locally adjusted evolutionarily stable strategy. Evolution, 46(5), 1408–1420.
* [Animal Diversity Web](https://animaldiversity.org/accounts/Spea_bombifrons/)

description:
Maip a megaraptor dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous period, strides into the prehistoric scene with a name that reflects both its size and predatory nature. Despite its name, it's important to note that Megaraptor is not a true member of the dromaeosaurid family, which includes famous raptors like Velociraptor.

Characterized by its large size and long, sickle-shaped claws on its feet, Megaraptor was likely a powerful predator. Fossil evidence suggests it had a sleek and agile build, making it well-adapted for hunting.

description:
3D scan of the skull of an adult loggerhead sea turtle (*Caretta caretta*). 

The loggerhead sea turtle (*Caretta caretta*) is a species of oceanic turtle belonging to the family Cheloniidae distributed throughout the world. It is found in the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans, as well as the Mediterranean Sea. The average loggerhead measures around 90 cm in carapace length when fully grown and the adult weighs approximately 135 kg, with the largest specimens weighing in at more than 450 kg.
The loggerhead sea turtle is omnivorous, feeding mainly on bottom-dwelling invertebrates. Its large and powerful jaws serve as an effective tool for dismantling its prey.

Specimen: Loggerhead sea turtle, *Caretta caretta* (Linnaeus, 1758)

name: Kissing Bug (Rhodnius robustus) - Patasyacu, ECU
description:
This kissing bug (*Rhodnius robustus*) was collected in Patasyacu, Ecuador and 3D-scanned using [scAnt](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/scant-open-source-3d-insect-scanner-234556e5bb714c30942f779ca582455e) by [EvoBiomech](https://sketchfab.com/EvoBiomech).

This insect is part of the [Infectious and Tropical Diseases Research Division](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/research/research-groups/476-itd.html) collection at the [CISeAL](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/) (Center for Research on Health in Latin America). This research complex studies tropical diseases in order to mitigate their effects and potentially eradicate them for good.

*Rhodnius robustus* is a vector of Chagas disease in several countries of Central and South America (including Ecuador).

Reconstructed from 140 photos using RealityCapture 1.2 and further processed with Blender 3.3.1.

Scanned by: [Alvaro Lara](https://sketchfab.com/baru7279)
